title: Real Optional AI Integrations
objective: Connect approved live AI providers through the MIB-15 abstraction only after no-AI and fake-provider behavior is proven. Cover writing help, worldbuilding, GM assistance, context/search help and permitted AutoGM presentation while keeping providers replaceable/advisory and enforcing cost, privacy and provenance controls. SAA may consume assistance only through its proposal-only boundary.
acceptance: Approved live providers are reached only through the sealed MIB-15 abstraction; provider-specific behavior cannot become a new canonical owner.
Every blocking Player/GM/Creator workflow remains valid with AI disabled, and deterministic fake/local-provider behavior remains available for validation.
Writing, worldbuilding, GM, context/search and permitted AutoGM outputs remain advisory/proposal state until an authorized owner action adopts them.
SAA assistance remains proposal-only and cannot silently commit Character, Scene, Dialogue, page/panel/layer, history or narrative truth.
Provider selection remains replaceable and capability-driven; unavailable or incompatible providers fail closed without silently substituting authority.
Cost controls, privacy/context scope and provider/proposal provenance are explicit before live-provider use.
Optional AI never becomes a paid-cloud requirement for blocking workflows, and provider-off/local operation remains a supported core path.
SMB-13 and later remote-alpha work remain unauthorized until verified SMB-12 closeout.
boundaries: SMB-01..11, SMB10A/B and SAA-01..30 remain sealed predecessor contracts.
MIB-15 remains canonical AI-provider abstraction authority; SMB-12 integrates providers but does not create a parallel provider registry or canonical domain truth.
AI results are advisory/proposal outputs and cannot silently mutate Campaign, World, Character, Scene, Dialogue, SAA or narrative owner state.
No paid provider is required for blocking product operation or validation.
No public release, remote tester distribution, commerce, marketplace/community publication or SMB-13 authority is granted.
SMB-13 remains blocked until verified SMB-12 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for optional provider integration strictly through MIB-15, provider-off/fake-provider parity, advisory proposal outputs, capability-driven replaceable providers, explicit cost/privacy/provenance controls, and fail-closed unavailable/incompatible providers; then implement only SMB-12.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started SMB-12 after verified SMB-11 closeout.
